NATIONAL WATER SUPPLY AND DRAINAGE BOARD, ACT, No. 2 OF 1974
Order under Section 92

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No. 2 of 1974,I, Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education hereby approve the acquisition of theimmovable property, described in the following Schedule, as it is required by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board,for the construction of Access Road to Waragolla Ground Storage Tank of Hasalaka Water Supply Project.
RAUFF HAKEEM,Minister of City Planning, Water Supplyand Higher Education.
